source_clause: LS3.) The user will be able to long press on the hard button (-, +) or on the touch screen itself to initiate fast increases/decreases. (See HMI Core Logic and Flow, requirement N0.)
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.4（LS3.）長按 (-, +) 或觸控螢幕啟動快速增減。關鍵情境條件：依 19 §4.1 收窄 —— 長按之判定門檻、重複速率、加速曲線由 HMI Core Logic and Flow requirement N0 擁有，不在本 feature 範圍，不測、不補值，故 procedure 不指定按壓時長、ER 不述速率。為什麼這樣切：037 拆為「快速增減被啟動」與「邏輯依 Core N0」兩個 leaf。刻意略過：-080-02 之區別內容純為上述委派，且其 Verification Criteria 之 Action 與 -01 相同（兩個操作面本就同在 -01），扣除委派後無餘留 —— 依 20 §2.1 回報停下，待裁（見 split_reason）。

tcs.tc_title: Long press initiates fast lumbar level change
tcs.test_item: The user will be able to long press on the hard button (-, +) or on the touch screen itself to initiate fast increases/decreases
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [test-setup] The Seats tab is open and the lumbar/bolster level is away from both its minimum and its maximum
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the lumbar/bolster state shown before the adjustment
2. Long press "+" on the door seat control
3. Release "+"
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lumbar/bolster state before the adjustment is shown
2. The lumbar/bolster increases faster than it does for a single short press
3. The lumbar/bolster stops increasing
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Long press logic follows HMI Core Logic and Flow
tcs.test_item: The user will be able to long press on the touch screen itself to initiate fast increases/decreases, with the long-press logic as per HMI Core Logic and Flow (requirement N0)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [test-setup] The Seats tab is open and the lumbar/bolster level is away from both its minimum and its maximum
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: [BLOCKED-SPEC] Long-press logic is defined by HMI Core Logic and Flow requirement N0. With that delegation removed this requirement has no content left that can be verified against the Comfort HMI specification alone
